name: Appwrite
symbol: Cron schedules for functions on Free and Education plans
title: Appwrite: Cron schedules for functions on Free and Education plans (behavior change)
summary: From Monday, October 19, 2026, cron schedules for functions on Appwrite Cloud will need a paid plan. Functions on the Free and Education plans run on an interval of 60 minutes or longer
replacement: Upgrade to a paid plan to keep cron, or select Interval in function Settings > Executions > Schedule, or replace schedule with interval in SDK calls, CLI config, or Terraform resource.

name: Appwrite
symbol: Inactive function and site deployments on Appwrite Cloud
title: Appwrite: Inactive function and site deployments on Appwrite Cloud (new default)
summary: From November 5, 2026, inactive deployments on Appwrite Cloud are kept for 30 days by default, and you can keep them for longer, up to your plan's maximum
replacement: Set a longer retention period in your function or site under Settings > Build > Retention before November 5. Free and Education plans can keep inactive deployments up to 90 days, and Start and Pro plans up to 3 years.
